prompt_body:
## Goal

Realistic candid lifestyle photography, 9:16 vertical, modern East Asian summer portrait, strong photographic texture, clean frame, clear large-shape relationships, explicit spatial layering.

## Subject

an adult East Asian woman with a quiet demeanor and natural camera awareness, wearing resort style.

## Frame

midsummer lotus pond. shading herself with a giant lotus leaf, faint almost-smile.
waist-up medium close-up, 85mm compressed portrait, low-angle shot from beneath giant lotus leaves, lotus leaves forming a natural circular frame.
Foreground: giant lotus leaves. The foreground must intrude naturally into the frame and form a clear occlusion; do not show every element in full.
Light: dappled light through tree shade. Palette: teal green + off-white + a few pink flowers. Keep at most 3-4 major color blocks; avoid a multicolored frame.
Photography state: natural candid capture.

## Avoid

No studio portrait look, no commercial studio shoot, no standard influencer posing, no subject staring into the lens, no conventional centered portrait, no complex props, no cluttered background, no over-smoothing, no plastic skin.
